summary: Israel killed three senior terror operatives in Gaza while Iran-US negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz and nuclear program are set to resume Monday. The IRGC denies any Hormuz reopening agreement and maintains the strait remains closed, while tanker data shows continued oil flow. Meanwhile, Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon wounded Lebanese Army soldiers, and the IDF denied responsibility for an IED attack attributing it to Hezbollah.
key_points: IDF eliminated three Gaza terror operatives including a Hamas Jabalia Battalion commander, citing imminent attack threats. (Source: @manniefabian/58913)
Trump announced Iran-US negotiations restart Monday on Hormuz then nuclear; says planned attack would have been largest since WWII. (Source: @asafroz/52205)
IRGC denies Hormuz reopening deal; strait remains closed, passage only via IRGC Navy route; tanker data shows 7.5M bpd non-Iranian oil exported. (Source: @New_security8200/203152)
Lebanese Army reports 5 soldiers wounded in Israeli strike on Bint Jbeil; separate strike reported on Ali Taher ridge. (Source: @inon_yttach/9782)
IDF denies IED that wounded 5 Lebanese soldiers in Kafra, attributes to Hezbollah outside security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/24811)
US CENTCOM officer seeks "creative, unconventional ways to pressure and punish Iran"; fighter jets heard over Iranian cities. (Source: @yediotnews25/133529)
Defense Minister Katz appoints Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa as Central Command chief; Chief of Staff freezes senior appointments until 2027. (Source: @yediotnews25/133522)
Explosions reported in Iraq's Salahuddin province; Baiji refinery hydrogen unit explosion due to technical fault. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86784)

sections.executive_summary: Israel killed three senior terror operatives in Gaza while Iran-US negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz and nuclear program are set to resume Monday. The IRGC denies any Hormuz reopening agreement and maintains the strait remains closed, while tanker data shows continued oil flow. Meanwhile, Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon wounded Lebanese Army soldiers, and the IDF denied responsibility for an IED attack attributing it to Hezbollah.

points: IRGC commander in Hormuz threatened that attackers on Iran will be buried in the same land and waters they approach, signaling resolve to defend the strait. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382656)

IRGC-owned Fars News denies any Hormuz reopening agreement; strait remains blocked amid US hostile actions, passage only via pre-declared route with IRGC Navy approval. (Source: @New_security8200/203152, @shin_persian/8787)

Tanker tracking data shows 7.5 million bpd of non-Iranian oil exported daily since IRGC announced full closure 21 days ago; 13 million barrels capacity entered Persian Gulf in last 24 hours. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78598)

Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson stated Iran is not negotiating with the US, only with Oman; Iran and Oman are in final stages of negotiations over a new Hormuz pathway that is not an official opening. (Source: @asafroz/52215, @Faytuks_Network/6030)

Trump declared a deal on Hormuz is coming and a denuclearization deal will follow; negotiations start Monday afternoon; planned attack on Iran would have been largest since WWII. (Source: @asafroz/52205, @mamlekate/104063, @shin_persian/8790)

Fighter jet sounds reported over Urmia, Hamadan, and parts of Tehran; PressTV reports US/Israeli airstrikes struck Iranian ports, bridges, transport corridors, hospitals, and civilian infrastructure. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78588, @presstv/201373)

Iran's acting defense minister connected with Turkish defense minister; Al Jazeera claims Pakistan and Qatar will send representatives to facilitate Iran-US talks. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382664, @SharghDaily/175948)

IDF announced three terror operatives killed in Gaza: Alaa Imad Khamis Tarams (Army of Islam), Hassan Ibrahim Shehadeh Qahman (PIJ), and Ahmad Khudar (Hamas Jabalia Battalion commander) in separate strikes; IDF says they were advancing attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/58913, @almogboker78/17877)

Defense Minister Katz appointed Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa as Central Command chief after Chief of Staff Zamir's recommendation; policy to promote commanders with proven aggressiveness in the "War of Independence." (Source: @yediotnews25/133522, @lelotsenzura/94034)
Chief of Staff Zamir froze senior officer appointments until 2027; Central Command chief to stay at least three years until summer 2026. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382655)

IDF denied responsibility for IED that wounded 5 Lebanese Army soldiers in Kafra, stating it was a Hezbollah IED outside the security zone where IDF forces were not present. (Source: @idf_telegram/24811)
Senior US CENTCOM officer emailed analysts seeking "new, creative, unconventional ways to pressure and punish Iran," indicating expanded pressure campaign. (Source: @yediotnews25/133529)
Trump stated US will avoid further attacks on Iran as long as agreement is reachable; negotiations with Iran to start Monday afternoon. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94031, @rodast_omiddana/78597)

Israeli warplanes reported flying over southern Lebanon sectors (eastern, central) at maximum alert; fake enemy raids reported in eastern and central sector airspace. (Source: @redlinkleb/34504, @redlinkleb/34501)

IDF killed three terror operatives in Gaza: Alaa Imad Khamis Tarams (Army of Islam) and Hassan Ibrahim Shehadeh Qahman (PIJ) in Gaza City yesterday; Ahmad Khudar (Hamas Jabalia Battalion commander) in northern Gaza last week. (Source: @manniefabian/58913, @almogboker78/17877)
IDF justified strikes amid ceasefire, stating operatives were advancing attacks and were eliminated to remove the threat. (Source: @manniefabian/58913)
IRGC statement on Haniyeh assassination anniversary declared efforts to disarm Hamas have failed and collapsed; anti-Zionist resistance remains steadfast. (Source: @presstv/201340)
No specific West Bank operations reported in the current message set.
Lebanese Army reported 5 soldiers lightly wounded in Israeli airstrike on Bint Jbeil in South Lebanon. (Source: @inon_yttach/9782)
Lebanese media reported Israeli airstrike on Ali Taher ridge. (Source: @New_security8200/203157, @redlinkleb/34505)
IDF stated Lebanese Army vehicle hit an IED in Kafra, wounding 5 soldiers; IDF denied responsibility, attributing IED to Hezbollah outside the security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/24811)

Israeli warplanes flying over southern Lebanon sectors (eastern, central) at maximum alert; fake enemy raids reported in eastern and central sector airspace. (Source: @redlinkleb/34504, @redlinkleb/34501)
Map data shows activity from Nabatieh to Jirjou area. (Source: @redlinkleb/34513)
Explosions heard in Iraq's Salahuddin province. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86772)
Explosion inside Baiji refinery hydrogen unit in Salahuddin due to technical fault. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86786)
No specific Syria-related operational reports in the current message set.

Senior Gulf official (UAE) pushing Trump to escalate against Iran, saying Iran won't compromise until US escalates, including taking control of Hormuz and considering ground options. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6026)
Reporter asked Trump about US withdrawing forces from Kuwait and Bahrain; Trump declined to comment. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86778)
